_comment_target: Custom target for the UnboundOS bare-metal kernel. CPU is base x86_64; SIMD is NOT statically enabled here. The dispatch table picks tiers at runtime after CPUID/XCR0 probing. Adding `target-feature=+avx2` here would bypass the loader-selected dispatch and is forbidden per CLAUDE.md Section 3.
_comment_features: Soft-float and disabled SIMD at the base ABI level. The kernel enables SSE/AVX bits via CR0/CR4/XCR0 manipulation only after CPUID confirms support. SIMD-using crates (notably crates/llm) opt in per-function via #[target_feature] on functions reachable only through the dispatch table.
